main.description: Stop an account being a customer: remove it from the customers space. Removing a non-member succeeds. Staff only.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not HappyProto staff, or may not change the customers space's members: only its creator or a HappyView super user may.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The customers space is not configured, or could not be changed.
